intrinsics.assumption: Independent horizontal54deg FOV unless --fov overrides; not measured

units: arbitrary declared scene metres; not measured metric depth

gaussianEncoding.color: original unresized sRGB pixels encoded SH0 (rgb-.5)/sqrt(1/(4*pi))
gaussianEncoding.scale: log principal standard deviations; tangent sigma=z*footprint/f, thickness=.08*tangent
gaussianEncoding.quaternion: wxyz; camera-plane tangent axes identity; no edge-gradient stretching

reconstruction.method: Depth Anything V2 Small relative inverse-depth inference, independent per-pixel backprojection, no triangle connectivity

license.weights: Depth-Anything-V2-Small Apache-2.0; no Base/Large/Giant weights used
license.attribution: Depth Anything V2, Lihe Yang et al.; source LICENSE preserved

limitations: Relative depth mapped to a declared unmeasured scale; focal length assumed independently.
Visible colored surface only; hidden geometry is unknown, not a closed CAD model.
Lighting/reflections encoded in source colors; no relightable PBR material reconstruction.
No SHARP model, predicted depth, PLY or camera metadata used.
